steps: Crisis: control with a titratable agent (IV phentolamine / nicardipine).
Establish ALPHA-blockade FIRST (phenoxybenzamine/doxazosin) - never beta-block before alpha (unopposed alpha → crisis).
Add beta-blockade later for tachyarrhythmia, after adequate alpha-blockade and volume repletion.
Liberal salt/fluid to restore volume pre-operatively.
Definitive: surgical resection after adequate blockade (≈2 weeks); endocrine/surgical MDT.

confirm: Paroxysmal hypertension with headache, sweating, palpitations; raised plasma/urine metanephrines; tumour on imaging.
